Method of Attack: Improper validation of recipient addresses in the deliver_message() function leading to Remote Command Execution (RCE) with root privileges
Exploitation via RCPT TO commands in non-default configurations
Local and remote exploitation by manipulating recipient verification ACLs and local part suffixes
Remote exploitation requiring keeping connection open for 7 days in default configuration
Impacted Systems: Exim mail transfer agent versions 4.87 to 4.91
Attack Vector: Unauthenticated remote attacker sending specially crafted RCPT TO commands
Local attacker exploiting recipient address validation
Remote attacker exploiting non-default Exim configurations such as removed 'verify = recipient' ACL, local_part_suffix settings, or relay_to_domains
Indicators of Compromise: Exploit attempts using RCPT TO commands with payloads like balrog+${run{...}}@localhost or ${run{...}}@khazad.dum
